verses.text: For di third month after di pikin dem of Israel don go out of di land of Egypt, for di same day dem come into di wilderness of Sinai.
Dem journey from Rephidim, come to di wilderness of Sinai, and encamp for di wilderness. Israel encamp dere before di mountain.
Moses go up to God, and di Lord call to am out of di mountain, talk, “Na so you go talk to di house of Jacob, and tell di pikin dem of Israel:
‘Una don see wetin I do to di Egyptians, and how I carry una on eagles wings, and bring una to myself.
Now therefore, if una go obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, una go be my own possession from among all peoples, because all di earth na mine.
Una go be to me one kingdom of priests, and one holy nation.’ Dis na di words wey you go speak to di pikin dem of Israel.”
Moses come and call for di elders of di people, and set before dem all dis words wey di Lord command am.
All di people answer together, and talk, “All wey di Lord don talk we go do.” Moses report di words of di people to di Lord.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Look, I dey come to you for thick cloud, so that di people go hear when I speak with you, and go believe you forever.” Moses tell di words of di people to di Lord.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Go to di people, and make dem holy today and tomorrow, and make dem wash dem clothes,
and make dem ready for di third day, because for di third day di Lord go come down for di sight of all di people on Mount Sinai.
You go set bounds for di people round about, talk, ‘Beware say una no go up into di mountain, or touch di border of am. Whoever touch di mountain go surely die.
No hand go touch am, but e go surely dey stoned, or shot through. Whether na animal or man, e no go live.’ When di ram horn sound long, dem go come up to di mountain.”
Moses go down from di mountain to di people, and e make di people holy, and dem wash dem clothes.
E talk to di people, “Make ready for di third day. No come near to woman.”

E come be say for di third day, when morning come, dere dey thunders and lightnings, and thick cloud on di mountain, and di sound of one trumpet very loud, and all di people wey dey for di camp tremble.
Moses bring di people out of di camp to meet with God, and dem stand for di lower part of di mountain.
Mount Sinai dey completely for smoke, because di Lord descend on am for fire. Im smoke go up like di smoke of one furnace, and di whole mountain quake greatly.
When di sound of di trumpet grow louder and louder, Moses speak, and God answer am by voice.
Di Lord come down on Mount Sinai, to di top of di mountain. Di Lord call Moses to di top of di mountain, and Moses go up.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Go down, warn di people, make dem no break through to di Lord to gaze, and many of dem perish.
Make di priests too, wey come near to di Lord, make demself holy, otherwise di Lord go break out on dem.”
Moses talk to di Lord, “Di people no fit come up to Mount Sinai, because you charge us, talk, ‘Set bounds around di mountain, and make am holy.’”
Di Lord talk to am, “Go, get down, and you go come up, you, and Aaron with you, but no make di priests and di people break through to come up to di Lord, otherwise e go break out against dem.”
So Moses go down to di people, and tell dem.
God speak all dis words, talk,
“I na di Lord your God, wey bring you out of di land of Egypt, out of di house of bondage.
You go get no other gods before me.
You no go make for yourself one carved image, or any likeness of anything wey dey heaven above, or wey dey di earth beneath, or wey dey di water under di earth.

You no go bow yourself down to dem, nor serve dem, because I, di Lord your God, na jealous God, visiting di iniquity of di papa dem on di pikin dem, on di third and on di fourth generation of dem wey hate me,
and showing lovingkindness to thousands of dem wey love me and keep my commandments.
You no go take di name of di Lord your God in vain, because di Lord no go hold am guiltless wey take im name in vain.
Remember di Sabbath day, to keep am holy.
Six days you go labour, and do all your work,

but di seventh day na Sabbath to di Lord your God. For am you no go do any work, you, nor your pikin man, nor your pikin woman, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger wey dey inside your gates.
Because for six days di Lord make heaven and earth, di sea, and all wey dey inside dem, and rest on di seventh day. Na why di Lord bless di Sabbath day, and make am holy.
Honour your papa and your mama, so that your days go dey long for di land wey di Lord your God dey give you.
You no go murder.
You no go commit adultery.
You no go steal.
You no go give false testimony against your neighbour.
You no go covet your neighbour house. You no go covet your neighbour wife, nor im male servant, nor im female servant, nor im ox, nor im donkey, nor anything wey be your neighbour own.”
All di people perceive di thunderings, di lightnings, di sound of di trumpet, and di mountain smoking. When di people see am, dem tremble, and stand far off.
Dem talk to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we go listen, but make God no speak with us, otherwise we go die.”
Moses talk to di people, “No fear, because God don come to test una, and so that im fear go dey before una, so that una no go sin.”
Di people stand far off, and Moses go near to di thick darkness wia God dey.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Na so you go talk to di pikin dem of Israel: ‘Una don see say I don talk with una from heaven.
Una no go make with me gods of silver, and una no go make gods of gold for yourselves.

Una go make one altar of earth for me, and sacrifice on am your burnt offerings, and your peace offerings, your sheep, and your cattle. For every place wia I record my name I go come to you and I go bless you.
If una go make me one altar of stone, una no go build am of cut stones, because if una lift up your tool on am, una don pollute am.
Una no go go up by steps to my altar, so that your nakedness no go dey uncovered for am.’”
“Now dem na di ordinances wey you go set before dem.
If you buy one Hebrew servant, e go serve six years, and for di seventh e go go out free for nothing.
If e come in by imself, e go go out by imself. If e dey married, im wife go go out with am.
If im oga give am wife, and di wife born am pikin man dem or pikin woman dem, di wife and di pikin dem go be im oga own, and e go go out by imself.
But if di servant plainly talk, ‘I love my oga, my wife, and my pikin dem. I no go go out free,’
im oga go bring am to God, and go bring am to di door, or to di doorpost. Im oga go bore im ear with one awl, and e go serve am forever.
If one man sell im pikin woman to be servant, di woman no go go out as di male servants do.
If di girl no good for di eyes of di oga wey engage am for imself, e must let dem redeem am. E no get power to sell am to foreign people, seeing say e don deal deceitfully with am.
If e engage am to im pikin man, e go deal with am according to di custom of pikin woman dem.
If e take another wife to imself, di first one food, clothing, and marital rights e no go diminish.
If e no do dis three things for am, di girl go go out free, without money.
Whoever strike man so that e die, go surely dey put to death.
If e no lie in wait, but God deliver am into im hand, I go appoint for you one place wia e go flee.
If one man come presumptuously on im neighbour, to kill am with guile, you go take am from my altar, so that e go die.
Whoever strike im papa or im mama go surely dey put to death.
Whoever steal one man, and sell am, or if dem find am for im hand, go surely dey put to death.
Whoever curse im papa or im mama go surely dey put to death.
If men quarrel, and one strike im neighbour with stone, or with fist, and e no die, but dey confined to im bed,
if e rise again, and waka outside with im staff, di one wey strike am go dey clear. Only e go pay for im loss of time, and go cause am to dey thoroughly healed.
If one man strike im servant, male or female, with rod, and e die under im hand, e go surely dey punished.
Notwithstanding, if e live a day or two, e no go dey punished, because na im money.
If men fight, and hurt one pregnant woman so that di pikin dem come out, but no harm follow, e go surely dey fined, as di woman husband go demand of am. E go pay as di judges determine.
But if any harm follow, you go give life for life,
eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
If one man strike di eye of im servant, or di eye of im female servant, and destroy am, e go let am go free for di eye sake.
If e knock out im male servant tooth, or im female servant tooth, e go let am go free for di tooth sake.
If one ox gore one man or woman to death, di ox go surely dey stoned, and im flesh no go dey eaten, but di owner of di ox go dey clear.
But if di ox dey accustomed to gore in time past, and dem don warn im owner, and e no keep am in, and e kill one man or woman, di ox go dey stoned, and im owner too go dey put to death.
If dem lay on am di sum of money to redeem im life, e go give wetin dem lay on am.
Whether e don gore one pikin man or pikin woman, according to dis judgment e go dey done to am.
If di ox gore one male servant or female servant, e go give to im oga 30 shekels of silver, and di ox go dey stoned.
If one man open one pit, or if one man dig one pit and no cover am, and one ox or donkey fall inside,
di owner of di pit go make am good. E go give money to im owner, and di dead animal go be im own.
If one man ox hurt another own so that e die, dem go sell di live ox, and divide di money of am. Di dead animal too dem go divide.
Or if e dey known say di ox dey accustomed to gore in time past, and im owner no keep am in, e go surely pay ox for ox, and di dead animal go be im own.
If one man steal one ox or one sheep, and kill am or sell am, e go pay five oxen for one ox, and four sheep for one sheep.
If di thief dey found breaking in, and dem strike am so that e die, no blood-guilt go dey for am.
If di sun don rise on am, dere go dey blood-guilt for am. E must make full restitution. If e get nothing, e go dey sold for im theft.
If di stolen animal dey found alive for im hand, whether ox, donkey, or sheep, e go pay double.

If one man cause one field or vineyard to dey grazed, and e let im animal loose, and e graze for another man field, e go make restitution from di best of im own field, and from di best of im own vineyard.
If fire break out, and catch for thorns, so that di stacked grain, or di standing grain, or di field dey consumed, di one wey kindle di fire go surely make restitution.
If one man deliver to im neighbour money or stuff to keep, and e dey stolen out of di man house, if di thief dey found, e go pay double.
If di thief no dey found, di master of di house go come near to God, to see whether e don put im hand on im neighbour goods.

For every matter of trespass, whether e be for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, wey one talk say, ‘Dis na mine,’ di cause of both parties go come before God. Whoever God condemn go pay double to im neighbour.
If one man deliver to im neighbour one donkey, or ox, or sheep, or any animal to keep, and e die, or dey hurt, or dey driven away, no man seeing am,
di oath of di Lord go dey between dem two, say whether e don put im hand on im neighbour goods. Di owner of am go accept am, and e no go make restitution.
But if e dey stolen from am, e go make restitution to di owner of am.
If e dey torn in pieces, make am bring am for witness. E no go make good wetin dey torn.
If one man borrow anything from im neighbour, and e dey hurt or die, di owner no dey with am, e go surely make restitution.
If di owner dey with am, e no go make am good. If e dey hired, e don come for im hire.
If one man entice one virgin wey no dey engaged, and lie with am, e go surely pay dowry for am to be im wife.
If im papa utterly refuse to give am to am, e go pay money according to di dowry of virgins.
You no go allow one sorceress to live.
Whoever lie with one animal go surely dey put to death.
Im wey sacrifice to any god, except to di Lord alone, go dey utterly destroyed.
You no go wrong one stranger, neither oppress am, because una dey strangers for di land of Egypt.
You no go afflict any widow or orphan.
If you afflict dem at all, and dem cry at all to me, I go surely hear dem cry.
My wrath go burn, and I go kill una with di sword. Una wives go be widows, and una pikin dem go be fatherless.
If you lend money to any of my people wey dey poor by you, you no go be to am as one wey dey lend with interest. Una no go charge am interest.
If you take your neighbour garment to pledge, you go restore am to am before di sun go down,
because dat na im only covering. Na im garment for im skin. Wetin e go sleep in? E go come be say when e cry to me, I go hear, because I dey gracious.
You no go blaspheme God, nor curse one ruler of your people.
You no go delay to offer from di abundance of your harvest and from di outflow of your presses. Di firstborn of your pikin man dem you go give to me.
Na so you go do with your oxen and with your sheep. E go dey with im mama seven days. On di eighth day you go give am to me.
Una go be holy men to me. Una no go eat any flesh wey dem tear by animals for di field. Una go throw am to di dogs.
You no go spread one false report. No join hands with di wicked to be malicious witness.
You no go follow one multitude to do evil. You no go testify for one lawsuit to turn aside after many to pervert justice.
Neither go you favour one poor man for im cause.
If you meet your enemy ox or im donkey wandering, you go surely bring am back to am again.
If you see di donkey of one wey hate you lying under im load, and you go refrain from helping am, you go surely help di owner with am.
You no go wrest di judgment of your poor for im cause.
Keep far from one false matter, and no kill di innocent and righteous, because I no go justify di wicked.
You no go take one bribe, because one bribe blind di wise, and pervert di words of di righteous.
You no go oppress one stranger, because una know di heart of one stranger, seeing say una dey strangers for di land of Egypt.
Six years you go sow your land, and gather in im increase,

but di seventh year you go let am rest and lie fallow, so that di poor of your people go eat. Wetin dem leave, di animals of di field go eat. Na so you go deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
Six days you go do your work, but on di seventh day you go rest, so that your ox and your donkey go rest, and di pikin of your servant and di stranger go dey refreshed.
Be careful for all things wey I don talk to you. Make no mention of di names of other gods. Make dem no dey heard out of your mouth.
Three times you go keep one feast to me for di year.

You go keep di feast of unleavened bread. For seven days you go eat unleavened bread, as I command you, for di time appointed for di month Abib, because for am you come out from Egypt. None go appear before me empty.
Di feast of harvest, di firstfruits of your labours, wey you sow for di field. Di feast of ingathering, wey dey di end of di year, when you gather in your labours from di field.
Three times for di year all your males go appear before di Lord God.
You no go offer di blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. Di fat of my feast no go remain until morning.
You go bring di first of di firstfruits of your ground to di house of di Lord your God. You no go boil one young goat for im mama milk.
Look, I send one angel before you, to keep you for di way, and to bring you into di place wey I don prepare.
Pay attention to am, and listen to im voice. No provoke am, because e no go pardon your transgression, because my name dey inside am.
But if you indeed listen to im voice, and do all wey I speak, I go be enemy to your enemies, and adversary to your adversaries.
Because my angel go go before you, and bring you in to di Amorites, di Hittites, di Perizzites, di Canaanites, di Hivites, and di Jebusites. I go cut dem off.
You no go bow down to dem gods, nor serve dem, nor do according to dem works, but you go utterly overthrow dem, and break dem pillars in pieces.
You go serve di Lord your God, and e go bless your bread and your water. I go take sickness away from among you.
No one go miscarry or dey barren for your land. I go fulfill di number of your days.
I go send my terror before you, and go confuse all di people to wey you go come, and I go make all your enemies turn dem backs to you.
I go send hornets before you, wey go drive out di Hivite, di Canaanite, and di Hittite from before you.
I no go drive dem out from before you in one year, so that di land no go become desolate, and di animals of di field multiply against you.
Little by little I go drive dem out from before you, until you dey increased, and inherit di land.

I go set your border from di Red Sea even to di sea of di Philistines, and from di wilderness to di River. Because I go deliver di inhabitants of di land into your hand, and you go drive dem out before you.
You no go make any covenant with dem, nor with dem gods.
Dem no go dwell for your land, otherwise dem go make you sin against me, because if you serve dem gods, e go surely be one snare to you.”
E talk to Moses, “Come up to di Lord, you, Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and 70 of di elders of Israel, and worship from far off.
Moses alone go come near to di Lord, but dem no go come near, neither go di people go up with am.”
Moses come and tell di people all di words of di Lord, and all di ordinances. All di people answer with one voice, and talk, “All di words wey di Lord don talk we go do.”
Moses write all di words of di Lord, and e rise up early for morning, and build one altar under di mountain, and 12 pillars, according to di 12 tribes of Israel.
E send young men of di pikin dem of Israel, wey offer burnt offerings, and sacrifice peace offerings of oxen to di Lord.
Moses take half of di blood, and put am for basins, and half of di blood e sprinkle on di altar.
E take di book of di covenant, and read am for di ears of di people. Dem talk, “All wey di Lord don talk we go do, and obey.”
Moses take di blood, and sprinkle am on di people, and talk, “Look, di blood of di covenant, wey di Lord don make with una concerning all dis words.”
Den Moses go up, with Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and 70 of di elders of Israel,
and dem see di God of Israel. Under im feet na like one paved work of sapphire stone, and like di very heaven for clearness.
Upon di nobles of di pikin dem of Israel e no lay im hand. Dem see God, and dem eat and drink.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Come up to me on di mountain, and stay dere, and I go give you di tablets of stone, and di law and di commandment, wey I don write, so that you go teach dem.”
Moses rise up with im servant Joshua, and Moses go up onto God mountain.
E talk to di elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to una. Look, Aaron and Hur dey with una. Whoever get any matter, make am come to dem.”
Moses go up onto di mountain, and di cloud cover di mountain.
Di glory of di Lord stay on Mount Sinai, and di cloud cover am six days. Di seventh day e call to Moses out of di middle of di cloud.
Di appearance of di glory of di Lord dey like devouring fire on di top of di mountain for di eyes of di pikin dem of Israel.
Moses enter di middle of di cloud, and go up onto di mountain. Moses dey for di mountain 40 days and 40 nights.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, make dem take one offering for me. Of every man wey give am willingly with im heart, una go take my offering.
Dis na di offering wey una go take from dem: gold, silver, bronze,
blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats hair,
rams skins dyed red, hides of sea cows, acacia wood,
oil for di light, spices for di anointing oil and for di sweet incense,
onyx stones, and stones to set for di ephod and for di breastplate.
Make dem make me one sanctuary, so that I go dwell among dem.
According to all wey I show you, di pattern of di tabernacle, and di pattern of all im furniture, even so una go make am.
Dem go make one ark of acacia wood. Im length go be two and half cubits, im width one and half cubits, and im height one and half cubits.
You go overlay am with pure gold. Inside and outside you go overlay am, and you go make on am one moulding of gold round about.
You go cast four rings of gold for am, and put dem for im four feet, two rings on di one side of am, and two rings on di other side of am.
You go make poles of acacia wood, and overlay dem with gold.
You go put di poles into di rings on di sides of di ark, to carry di ark with dem.
Di poles go dey inside di rings of di ark. Dem no go dey taken from am.
You go put into di ark di testimony wey I go give you.
You go make one mercy seat of pure gold. Im length go be two and half cubits, and im width one and half cubits.
You go make two cherubim of gold. Of beaten work you go make dem, for di two ends of di mercy seat.
Make one cherub for di one end, and one cherub for di other end. Of di mercy seat una go make di cherubim on im two ends.
Di cherubim go spread out dem wings on high, covering di mercy seat with dem wings, with dem faces toward each other. Di faces of di cherubim go be toward di mercy seat.
You go put di mercy seat on top of di ark, and for di ark you go put di testimony wey I go give you.

Dere I go meet with you, and I go speak with you from above di mercy seat, from between di two cherubim wey dey on di ark of di testimony, of all things wey I go give you for commandment to di pikin dem of Israel.
You go make one table of acacia wood. Im length go be two cubits, im width one cubit, and im height one and half cubits.
You go overlay am with pure gold, and make for am one moulding of gold round about.
You go make for am one border of one handbreadth round about, and you go make one golden moulding for im border round about.
You go make for am four rings of gold, and put di rings for di four corners wey dey im four feet.
Di rings go dey close to di border, as places for di poles to carry di table.
You go make di poles of acacia wood, and overlay dem with gold, so that di table go dey carried with dem.
You go make im dishes, im spoons, im pitchers, and im bowls, wey dem go use pour out. You go make dem of pure gold.
You go set di bread of presence on di table before me always.
You go make one lampstand of pure gold. Of beaten work di lampstand go dey made, im base, and im shaft. Im cups, im buds, and im flowers go be of di same piece with am.
Six branches go go out of im sides: three branches of di lampstand out of di one side, and three branches of di lampstand out of di other side.

Three cups made like almond blossoms, each with bud and flower, for di one branch, and three cups made like almond blossoms, each with bud and flower, for di other branch. So for di six branches wey go out of di lampstand.
For di lampstand itself, four cups made like almond blossoms, with dem buds and dem flowers.

Dere go be one bud under di first pair of branches wey dey of am, and one bud under di second pair of branches wey dey of am, and one bud under di third pair of branches wey dey of am, for di six branches wey go out of di lampstand.
Dem buds and dem branches go be of di same piece with am. All of am go be one beaten work of pure gold.
You go make di lamps of am, seven. Dem go light di lamps of am, so that dem go give light to di space in front of am.
Im snuffers and im trays go be of pure gold.
Of one talent of pure gold e go dey made, with all dem vessels.
See say you make dem after di pattern wey dem show you for di mountain.
Moreover you go make di tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. You go make dem with cherubim, di work of one skillful workman.
Di length of one curtain go be 28 cubits, and di width of one curtain four cubits. All di curtains go get one measure.
Five curtains go dey coupled together one to another, and di other five curtains go dey coupled one to another.
You go make loops of blue on di edge of one curtain from di edge for di coupling. Na so you go make for di edge of di outermost curtain, for di second coupling.
You go make 50 loops for di one curtain, and you go make 50 loops for di edge of di curtain wey dey di second coupling. Di loops go dey opposite to one another.
You go make 50 clasps of gold, and couple di curtains one to another with di clasps, so that di tabernacle go be one.
You go make curtains of goats hair for one tent over di tabernacle. You go make 11 curtains.
Di length of one curtain go be 30 cubits, and di width of one curtain four cubits. Di 11 curtains go get one measure.
You go couple five curtains by demself, and six curtains by demself, and you go double over di sixth curtain for di front of di tent.
You go make 50 loops on di edge of di one curtain wey dey outermost for di coupling, and 50 loops on di edge of di curtain wey join di second coupling.
You go make 50 clasps of bronze, and put di clasps into di loops, and couple di tent together, so that e go be one.
Di overhanging part wey remain of di curtains of di tent, di half curtain wey remain, go hang over di back of di tabernacle.

Di cubit on di one side, and di cubit on di other side, of wetin remain for di length of di curtains of di tent, go hang over di sides of di tabernacle on di one side and on di other side, to cover am.
You go make one covering for di tent of rams skins dyed red, and one covering of hides of sea cows above.
You go make di boards for di tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
Ten cubits go be di length of one board, and one and half cubits di width of one board.
Two tenons go dey for one board, joined one to another. Na so you go make for all di boards of di tabernacle.
You go make di boards for di tabernacle: 20 boards for di south side toward di south.
You go make 40 sockets of silver under di 20 boards, two sockets under one board for im two tenons, and two sockets under another board for im two tenons.
For di second side of di tabernacle, on di north side, 20 boards,
and dem 40 sockets of silver, two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
For di back of di tabernacle toward di west, you go make six boards.
You go make two boards for di corners of di tabernacle for di back.
Dem go dey double beneath, and together dem go dey complete to di top of am to one ring. Na so e go be for dem both. Dem go be for di two corners.
Dere go dey eight boards, and dem sockets of silver, 16 sockets, two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
You go make bars of acacia wood: five for di boards of di one side of di tabernacle,
and five bars for di boards of di other side of di tabernacle, and five bars for di boards of di side of di tabernacle for di back toward di west.
Di middle bar for di middle of di boards go pass through from end to end.
You go overlay di boards with gold, and make dem rings of gold to be places for di bars. You go overlay di bars with gold.
You go rear up di tabernacle according to im plan wey dem show you for di mountain.
You go make one veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. E go dey made with cherubim, di work of one skillful workman.
You go hang am on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold. Dem hooks go be of gold, upon four sockets of silver.
You go hang di veil under di clasps, and bring in di ark of di testimony inside di veil. Di veil go separate for una di holy place from di most holy.
You go put di mercy seat on di ark of di testimony for di most holy place.
You go set di table outside di veil, and di lampstand opposite di table on di side of di tabernacle toward di south. You go put di table on di north side.
You go make one screen for di door of di tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, di work of one embroiderer.
You go make for di screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay dem with gold. Dem hooks go be of gold. You go cast five sockets of bronze for dem.”
